# Browser Dependencies

Vendored locally to keep demo mode independent of CDNs at runtime.

- HTMX 2.0.4: https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.4/dist/htmx.min.js
  - Upstream: https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/tree/v2.0.4
  - License: htmx-LICENSE.txt (BSD 2-Clause).
- Lucide 0.468.0: https://unpkg.com/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js
  - Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0
  - License: lucide-LICENSE.txt (ISC, includes Feather MIT notice).

These are the only browser libraries. No npm installation or frontend build is required.
